page.overview:
What is Amaura?

Amaura is a small, dinosaur-like Pokémon with a pink-tipped membrane on the top of its small head. Its skin is light blue in color and its stomach has a white diamond shape on the underside. This blue-eyed Pokémon has a long neck with a blue gem on either side of its body. It was restored from a frozen fragment.

In the ancient world Amaura's cold habitat kept predators such as Tyranitar at bay. They are very docile creatures that generally prefer living in packs and away from other Pokémon.

Despite successful resurrection from their frozen fossils, Amaura struggle to live in the modern era's heat. Hence, most scientists and researchers deduce that Amaura that are born in the modern world have shorter lifespans than those from 100,00 years ago.

When an Amaura howls at the sky, it is said to be able to summon auroras that illuminate the nights.
